mapper.select: SELECT PROJ_ID AS "projectId", PROJ_NM AS "projectName", PROJ_STAT_CD AS "status", CTRT_END_DT AS "endDate" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ WHERE PROJ_ID=#{id}

SELECT i.ISSUE_ID AS "issueId", i.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", i.ISSUE_TTL AS "title", i.IMPR_CD AS "importance", COALESCE(c.CODE_NM,i.IMPR_CD) AS "importanceName", i.DDLN_DT AS "dueDate", i.ISSUE_STAT_CD AS "status", COALESCE(s.CODE_NM,i.ISSUE_STAT_CD) AS "statusName", i.ACTN_CN AS "action", i.REG_USER_ID AS "regUserId", COALESCE(u.USER_NM,i.REG_USER_ID) AS "regUserName", i.REG_DTTM AS "regDttm", i.MOD_USER_ID AS "modUserId", COALESCE(m.USER_NM,i.MOD_USER_ID) AS "modUserName", i.MOD_DTTM AS "modDttm" FROM TB_PJ_ISSUE i JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=i.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='IMPR' AND c.CODE=i.IMPR_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE s ON s.CODE_GRP_ID='ISSUE_STAT' AND s.CODE=i.ISSUE_STAT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.USER_ID=i.REG_USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER m ON m.USER_ID=i.MOD_USER_ID WHERE i.PROJ_ID=#{id} ORDER BY i.ISSUE_ID
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID=#{group} AND CODE=#{code} AND USE_YN='Y' AND DEL_YN='N')
